_comment: Manifest for scripts/generate-schemas.ts (W45). One entry per protocol. status=generated means a pinned upstream artifact is available to this repo — either shipped inside an exact-versioned npm dependency (npmPackage + artifactExport) or captured from upstream and committed under schemas/ (artifactPath + version + capturedBy) — and the TypeScript in packages/agent-harness-providers/src/protocol/ is emitted from it. status=missing-upstream-artifact means no such artifact can be obtained; the generator refuses to emit anything for it and exits non-zero unless --allow-missing is passed. As of the Codex/OpenCode integration work there are no missing entries: all three protocols are generated from real upstream artifacts.
_provenance: The two committed artifacts were captured from the real upstream binaries, not authored here. Re-capture with the `capturedBy` command on each entry and re-run `pnpm generate:schemas`; CI's `git diff --exit-code` then reports the drift. A committed artifact records its version explicitly because there is no installed package.json to read it from.

codex.capturedBy: node packages/agent-harness-providers/node_modules/@openai/codex/bin/codex.js app-server generate-json-schema --out <dir>  →  codex_app_server_protocol.schemas.json (the @openai/codex optionalDependency pinned in packages/agent-harness-providers/package.json)
codex._note: One self-contained artifact: 82 top-level definitions (the JSON-RPC envelope, initialize, and the approval/elicitation server requests) plus definitions.v2.* holding the 604 types of the current thread/turn API. The v2 namespace is flattened with a `V2` prefix because the two namespaces genuinely disagree — `RequestId` is defined differently in each — so a bare merge would silently pick one.

opencode.capturedBy:
npx --yes opencode-ai@1.18.25 opencode serve --port

&& curl -s http://127.0.0.1:

/doc → openapi.json
opencode._note: OpenAPI 3.1: schemas live under components.schemas rather than $defs, and the endpoint table is derived from `paths`. The generated OPENCODE_OPERATIONS table records which routes stream (text/event-stream) and which return JSON — the distinction the previous hand-written stand-in got backwards for POST /session/{sessionID}/message.
